acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt's AI scribe, Sidekick, works in 4 steps. First, AI Intake pulls patient answers from pre-visit intake forms directly into the initial evaluation. mainEntity.name: What is plan-of-care compliance automation, and why does it matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plan-of-care compliance automation refers to automatically monitoring whether patients are attending the visits their care plan requires and proactively reaching out when they fall behind. In Prompt, this means the system identifies under-scheduled patients and sends automated reminders to book, without any manual effort from front office staff. This matters because missed or incomplete plans of care are one of the most common causes of both poor patient outcomes and lost revenue in outpatient therapy. Prompt customers report a 20% improvement in plan-of-care adherence and a 14% average reduction in cancelled visits after implementing this automation.
